body: Follow-up: #649 isolates the cast/order correctness contract that must be preserved while optimizing GAS structural changes: explicit Completed/Cancelled/Failed outcomes, exactly-once finalization, and continuation only after Completed.

## PR #660 二次审计证据回收（来自 #663）

#663 属于本 issue 已要求的生产切片预算接线，不另建第二份预算合同：

- `AbilityExecSystem.MaxWorkUnitsPerSlice` 和 `EffectLifetimeSystem.MaxWorkUnitsPerSlice` 默认均为 `int.MaxValue`。
- `GameEngine` 构造两个生产路径时只注入 snapshot capacity，没有注入有限工作量预算：[`GameEngine.cs#L1328-L1335`](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/d45aa049ddea7ce5cb676875c318e6f6a65873f4/src/Core/Engine/GameEngine.cs#L1328-L1335)、[`GameEngine.cs#L1615-L1633`](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/d45aa049ddea7ce5cb676875c318e6f6a65873f4/src/Core/Engine/GameEngine.cs#L1615-L1633)。
- 现有 `GasExecutionBudgetTests` 只证明手动设置有限预算后可以跨 slice 恢复，不能证明生产配置已经接线。

新增验收：

- [ ] 共享 `GasRuntimeCapacity` 配置定义 AbilityExec 与 EffectProcessing 的有限正工作量预算。
- [ ] 缺失、零值、负值或无限值在加载期硬失败。
- [ ] `GameEngine` 生产构造后的实际工作量预算等于配置值。
- [ ] 生产接线测试直接从实际系统或运行状态读取预算，而不是只在测试中手动赋值。

#663 将作为重复审计票关闭。

## 三方审计补充（基线 `f8a1be2`）：InstantCompleteOrderSystem 在 chunk 迭代内可触发结构变更

与本票「瞬时结构变更」主题同源，建议并入验收：

- `InstantCompleteOrderSystem.cs:94` 在 `foreach (ref var chunk in World.Query(...))`（`:65`）内、持有 `ref OrderBuffer buffer = ref buffers[index]` 时调用 `BlackboardStoredTargetOps.CommitFromOrder`。
- `CommitFromOrder` → `SetPoint/SetHex/SetEntity` → `EnsureBlackboardBuffers`（`BlackboardStoredTargetOps.cs:236-252`）在宿主缺 blackboard 组件时最多执行三次 `world.Add`，archetype 迁移会使正在迭代的 chunk span 与活 ref 失效。
- 潜伏型（仅缺组件实体触发），但违反「热路径 0 结构变更」。

建议验收追加：

- [ ] blackboard 三组件（Int/Float/Spatial）由模板/生成期保证存在；`CommitFromOrder` 缺组件时硬失败（对齐 #669 的 TagState 合同方向），`EnsureBlackboardBuffers` 从热路径移除。

## PR #660 当前 HEAD 复核：InstantComplete 仍在 chunk 迭代中补组件

### 1. 概述

当前 HEAD `b3b6d317` 上，InstantComplete 处理持有 chunk span 和 `ref OrderBuffer` 时，可通过存储目标写入路径执行最多三次 `World.Add`。这是 ECS 热路径结构变更，可能使当前 chunk 引用失效；#646 本项仍是 P1 合并阻断。

### 2. 结构

所有可执行 InstantComplete 订单的实体必须在生成期或地图装配期具备完整黑板组件。运行系统只读写已有 SoA 数据；缺组件应在改变订单或目标状态前明确失败。

### 3. 详情

- `InstantCompleteOrderSystem.Update` 在 chunk 迭代中持有 `ref OrderBuffer` 并调用 `CommitFromOrder`：[InstantCompleteOrderSystem.cs#L65-L99](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Core/Gameplay/GAS/Systems/InstantCompleteOrderSystem.cs#L65-L99)。
- 下游 `EnsureBlackboardBuffers` 缺组件时直接 `World.Add`：[BlackboardStoredTargetOps.cs#L130-L170](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Core/Gameplay/GAS/Orders/BlackboardStoredTargetOps.cs#L130-L170)、[BlackboardStoredTargetOps.cs#L236-L251](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Core/Gameplay/GAS/Orders/BlackboardStoredTargetOps.cs#L236-L251)。
- 当前测试在系统前预装三类黑板组件，未覆盖危险分支：[BlackboardStoredTargetInfrastructureTests.cs#L72](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Tests/GasTests/BlackboardStoredTargetInfrastructureTests.cs#L72)、[BlackboardStoredTargetInfrastructureTests.cs#L173](https://github.com/MightyBubble/Ludots/blob/b3b6d31770352afee8ea20efcd71571bbd724412/src/Tests/GasTests/BlackboardStoredTargetInfrastructureTests.cs#L173)。

### 4. 场景

InstantComplete 实体来自模板、运行期生成或旧地图迁移，且漏装任一黑板组件。

### 5. 边界

- 禁止在 System Update/chunk 迭代内调用自动补装入口。
- 不用测试统一预装掩盖生产装配缺口。
- 不建立 InstantComplete 专用平行黑板。

### 6. UAT

```gherkin
功能: 瞬时完成订单不改变正在迭代实体的结构

场景: 开发者生成缺少存储目标组件的瞬时订单实体
  当实体准备进入订单系统
  那么装配阶段明确指出缺少的黑板组件
  并且系统不会在订单迭代中临时增加组件
  并且现有订单和目标状态保持不变
```

结论：当前 HEAD 未解决；#646 必须保持 OPEN。

PR #660 final audit at `df45bb8d54dfa419f33cde503d01dbcc75803c49` confirms #646 is implemented.

Root cause: `InstantCompleteOrderSystem` could enter stored-target commit while holding chunk spans and `ref OrderBuffer`, then add missing blackboard components. That structural change could invalidate the current archetype iteration, and capacity failure could still leave an order reported complete with an old or partial target.

Fix boundary: required entity state is assembled before play through the shared `EntityRuntimeStatePlan` used by scalar and batch creation. The runtime path only validates existing SoA components and performs an atomic stored-target preflight/commit; missing components, dead entity targets, or full blackboards fail before changing the active order or stored target.

Evidence on merge ref `2faeb815f`: `BlackboardStoredTargetInfrastructureTests` 17/17 and architecture guards 47/47 passed, including real missing-component and full-capacity regressions. Full HEAD GasTests have zero HEAD-only failed test names versus main; both PR checks pass; build has 0 errors; `git diff --check` passes.

Issue remains OPEN pending maintainer close policy; no close declaration was changed.
